reglesExercice.consigne: Memorize the question and answer. If you forget, the answer is revealed.

activites.question: When do we use 'will + verb'?
activites.reponseAttendue: For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'
activites.explication: For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'

activites.question: When do we use 'going to + verb'?
activites.reponseAttendue: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'
activites.explication: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'

activites.question: What is the Zero Conditional? (If + present, present)
activites.reponseAttendue: For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'
activites.explication: For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'

activites.question: What is the First Conditional? (If + present, will + verb)
activites.reponseAttendue: For real/possible future situations. Ex: 'If I pass the bac, I will go to university.'
activites.explication: For real/possible future situations. Ex: 'If I pass the bac, I will go to university.'

activites.question: What is the Second Conditional? (If + past, would + verb)
activites.reponseAttendue: For unreal/hypothetical present situations. Ex: 'If I had money, I would travel.'
activites.explication: For unreal/hypothetical present situations. Ex: 'If I had money, I would travel.'

activites.question: What is the Third Conditional? (If + past perfect, would have + pp)
activites.reponseAttendue: For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'
activites.explication: For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'

activites.question: Difference between 'will' and 'going to'?
activites.reponseAttendue: 'Will' = spontaneous/uncertain. 'Going to' = already planned or evidence-based.
activites.explication: 'Will' = spontaneous/uncertain. 'Going to' = already planned or evidence-based.

activites.question: What is the Future Continuous?
activites.reponseAttendue: Will + be + verb-ing. For actions in progress at a future time. Ex: 'At 8pm, I will be studying.'
activites.explication: Will + be + verb-ing. For actions in progress at a future time. Ex: 'At 8pm, I will be studying.'
